newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul names chief financial officer.

text.p: St. Paul Cos Inc said Monday it named Paul Liska as executive vice president and chief financial officer.
Liska will be responsible for overall corporate financial affairs, including management of St. Paul's $13 billion investment portfolio.
Liska had been president and chief executive of Rosemont, Ill.-based Specialty Foods Corp.
St. Paul provides insurance underwriting and insurance brokerage products and services.
The new position is effective immediately.

Liska succeeds Patrick Thiele, who was named president of the company's worldwide insurance operation, president of St. Paul Fire and Marine insurance business and president of St. Paul International.
Shares of St. Paul were trading up 1/8 to 61-1/2.
